evals.prompt: In this AI Customer Support Platform repo, design and implement the v1 TechStore synthetic data generator: company.yaml, operational SQLAlchemy models + Alembic migration, scripts/generate_data.py with --profile demo --seed 42, and labeled anomalies including double payment. Keep existing UUID ticket/customer PKs. Do not put order rows in the knowledge base.
evals.expected_output: A generator that writes coherent PostgreSQL rows with public_ids, FK integrity, company.yaml, and SCN-DOUBLE-PAY scenario; demo profile is deterministic.
expectations: Keeps UUID primary keys and adds public_id columns rather than replacing PKs with CUST-0001 strings
Does not rename the tickets table to support_tickets
Creates or updates data/company/company.yaml with refund.standard_window_days and simulation now
Generator builds customer → order → items → payments → shipment graph with reconciled totals
Includes a labeled double_payment anomaly with two paid payments for one order
Does not write operational order/payment rows into data/knowledge_base/

evals.prompt: Add synthetic scenarios for delayed shipment, delivered-but-missing, refund outside 30-day window, and high-value refund above R$1000. Export fixtures that evaluation cases can reference by stable IDs.
evals.expected_output: Anomaly catalog implemented in DB + scenarios.json with stable SCN-* ids and Portuguese user messages.
expectations: Delayed shipment has estimated_delivery before simulation_now and is not delivered
Delivered-missing sets shipment delivered with customer_received false
Outside-window case has delivery older than company.yaml refund window
High-value refund is pending_approval / requires_human_approval true
Fixture IDs are stable (SCN- prefix) not random UUIDs only

evals.prompt: Replace scripts/seed_demo.py so local bootstrap gets a small but coherent TechStore dataset instead of a single demo ticket, without generating 10,000 customers by default.
evals.expected_output: seed_demo or bootstrap runs --profile demo; v1/load remain explicit flags.
expectations: Default/local seed uses the demo profile not load/10k
Demo profile still contains every anomaly kind
Bootstrap path still runs after alembic upgrade
